steps.text: Leave Venore by the north-west exit towards the Amazon camp, to the large ruined building in the swamp, and go down its stairs.
steps.source: Leave Venore from the north-west exit, traveling north-west toward the Amazon Camp. Stop when you find a large ruined building immersed in the swamp (Mapper Coords 128.59, 124.215, 7). Go down the stairs to the basement of this building.

steps.text: If the door in the basement is locked: key 5010 is in this dead tree west of the building.
steps.source: Key 5010, if door is locked; this key can be obtained in 2 dead trees west of the villa (Mapper Coords 128.45, 124.220, 7).

steps.text: Go to the south end of the basement, through the door (key 5010 if it's locked) and down the stairs.
steps.source: Go to the south end of the basement to find a door. If it is locked, open it with Key 5010. Go in and down the stairs inside.
You may find one of the parchments on this floor. Go down again.

steps.text: Follow the cave (either way at the split) and drop down the hole at the end (skeletons).
steps.source: Follow the cave. When the cave splits in 2, pick either direction. Drop down the hole at the end of the cave.

steps.text: Follow the cave south and rope up at the end.
steps.source: Follow the cave south. Rope up at the end of the path.

steps.text: Follow the cave furthest south to the room with skeletons and drop down a hole.
steps.source: Follow the cave furthest south again to a room with a few Skeletons. Drop down either of the two holes in this room.

steps.text: Go east to the wall, then north to the stairs and go down (beholders).
steps.source: There are 4 Bonelords on this floor. Go east until you hit a wall and then follow the cave north to find stairs. Go down the stairs.

steps.text: Go north through the level 50 gate and through the big room (a skeleton and a beholder) to the teleporter in the north.
steps.source: To the north is a level 50 Gate of Expertise. Go through it and head north. There will be 1 Skeleton, 2 Bonelords and 1 Wyvern in this large room. Kill them and go through the teleporter to the north.

steps.text: Kill the Black Knight, the beholders and the scorpions in the round room.
steps.source: The teleporter brings you to a circular room with the Black Knight, 2 Bonelords, and a few Scorpions.
